summary: A 55 x 28 mm ESP32 development board, standing on two rows of nineteen pins. Its micro-USB powers it and carries its serial console through a CP2102 bridge, which is how it is flashed and how it says hello. This entry has the USB socket and not yet its header pins.

jacks.name: usb
jacks.label: USB
jacks.note: Power in, and the serial console out: flashing, and the sketch's hello.
